([[Jefferson Parish, Louisiana]]) | college = [[Louisiana–Lafayette Ragin' Cajuns men's basketball|Louisiana–Lafayette]] (2011–2014) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | highlights = * [[Lefty Driesell Award]] (2014) * 2× first team All-[[Sun Belt Conference|Sun Belt]] (2013–2014) * Sun Belt Defensive Player of the Year (2014) | medaltemplates = {{MedalSport | Men's [[basketball]]}} {{MedalCountry|{{USA}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Under-19 World Championship|FIBA World U19 Championship]]}} {{MedalGold| [[2013 FIBA Under-19 World Championship|2013 Czech Republic]] | [[United States men's national basketball team|National team]]}} }} '''Elfrid Payton, Jr.''' (born February 22, 1994) is an American [[basketball]] player. He recently completed his college career at the [[University of Louisiana at Lafayette]], where in 2014 he won the [[Lefty Driesell Award]] as national college defensive player of the year. He is the son of former [[Canadian Football League]] player [[Elfrid Payton (Canadian football)|Elfrid Payton]].{{cite web | last = Eisenberg | first = Jeff | title = Little-known Elfrid Payton emerges as the surprise of USA Basketball tryouts | work = [[Yahoo Sports]] | date = June 18, 2013| url = http://sports.yahoo.com/blogs/ncaab-the-dagger/little-known-elfrid-payton-emerges-surprise-usa-basketball-143136106.html | accessdate = May 5, 2014}} ==College career== Payton was an unheralded recruit from [[John Ehret High School]] in [[Jefferson Parish, Louisiana]]. A 6'3" [[point guard]], he chose to attend [[Louisiana–Lafayette Ragin' Cajuns men's basketball|Louisiana–Lafayette]]. After a promising freshman season in [[2011–12 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2011–12]], Payton came into his own as a sophomore, averaging 15.9 [[Points per game|points]], 5.5 [[Assists per game|assists]], 5.6 [[Rebounds per game|rebounds]] and 2.4 [[Steal (basketball)|steal]]s per game and was named first team All-[[Sun Belt Conference]].{{cite web | last = | first = | title = Payton & Long Earn Sun Belt Basketball Honors | work = [[Louisiana–Lafayette Ragin' Cajuns]] | date = March 6, 2013| url = http://www.ragincajuns.com/news/2013/3/6/MBB_0306132026.aspx?path=mbball | accessdate = May 5, 2014}} As a junior in [[2013–14 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2013–14]], Payton emerged as one of the top defensive players in college basketball. He raised his averages to 19.2 points, 5.9 assists, 6.0 rebounds and 2.3 steals per game and led the Ragin' Cajuns to the [[2014 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2014 NCAA Tournament]]. He was again named first team All-Sun Belt and was the conference Defensive Player of the Year. At the end of the season, he earned national defensive players of the year by winning the Lefty Driesell Award.{{cite web | last = Iles | first = Trey | title = UL-Lafayette point guard Elfrid Payton wins Lefty Driesell Award | work = [[The Times-Picayune]] | date = April 21, 2014| url = http://www.nola.com/sports/index.ssf/2014/04/ul-lafayette_point_guard_elfri.html | accessdate = May 5, 2014}} ==Professional career== Following his junior season, Payton declared his eligibility for the [[2014 NBA draft]].{{cite web | last = | first = | title = UL-Lafayette's Elfrid Payton declares for the NBA draft Monday | work = [[The Times-Picayune]] | date = April 4, 2014| url = http://www.nola.com/sports/index.ssf/2014/04/ul-lafayettes_elfrid_payton_de.html | accessdate = May 5, 2014}} ==International career== In the Summer of 2013, Payton was a surprise selection to the United States team for the [[2013 FIBA Under-19 World Championship]]. He averaged 6.1 points and 3.3 rebounds per game in 9 matches.{{cite web | last = | first = | title = Eighth FIBA Men's U19 World Championship - 2013 | work = [[USA Basketball]] | date = | url = http://www.usab.com/mens/u19/mu19_2013.html | accessdate = May 5, 2014}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== * [http://ragincajuns.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=3925&path=mbball Louisiana–Lafayette bio] {{Lefty Driesell Award}} {{Persondata | NAME = Payton, Elfrid | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = Elfrid Payton, Jr. | SHORT DESCRIPTION = American basketball player | DATE OF BIRTH = February 22, 1994 | PLACE OF BIRTH = [[Gretna, Louisiana]] | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Payton, Elfrid}} [[Category:1994 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:African-American basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Louisiana]] [[Category:Louisiana–Lafayette Ragin' Cajuns men's basketball players]] [[Category:People from Gretna, Louisiana]] [[Category:Point guards]]
